scenario.topic: Decide how to split the shared garden plot this season

options.name: Equal Six-Way Split
options.upside: Each participant receives an equal area of 100 square feet.
options.concern: No consideration for individual crop preferences or effort levels.

options.name: Preference-Based Allocation
options.upside: Participants receive plot sizes aligned with their crop preferences.
options.concern: Plot sizes vary, which may cause disagreements about fairness.

options.name: Crop-Type Grouping
options.upside: Plots are organized by crop type, facilitating shared care and resources.
options.concern: Participants growing different crops must share plots, reducing individual control.

options.name: Effort-Based Distribution
options.upside: Plot sizes reflect each participant’s contribution in hours worked.
options.concern: Requires tracking effort accurately and may cause disputes over recorded hours.

shared_context: Six participants need to decide how to divide a shared garden plot of 600 square feet for this growing season. The plot can be split evenly, by preference, by crop type, or by effort contributed.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a community gardener who values collaboration and shared knowledge.
personas.private_goal: To grow a variety of crops with others who share similar interests.

A.reason_for: Equal split is fair and simple, ensuring everyone gets the same space.
A.reason_against: Does not consider crop type grouping which helps shared care.

B.reason_for: Allows some flexibility in plot size based on preferences.
B.reason_against: Unequal plot sizes may cause fairness concerns and reduce collaboration.

C.reason_for: Grouping by crop type promotes shared care and resource efficiency, which aligns with my collaborative values.

D.reason_for: Effort-based distribution seems fair to reward contribution.
D.reason_against: Tracking effort accurately can be difficult and cause disputes.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a practical gardener who prefers straightforward and fair solutions.
personas.private_goal: To have a guaranteed equal share of the garden without complications.

A.reason_for: Equal split is clear and ensures fairness with no disputes over size.

B.reason_against: Unequal sizes may lead to disagreements.

C.reason_for: Grouping by crop type could be efficient but complicates individual control.
C.reason_against: I prefer clear, equal shares rather than shared plots.

D.reason_against: Requires effort tracking which may be cumbersome.

personas.name: Noah
personas.background: Noah enjoys gardening as a relaxing hobby and values simplicity.
personas.private_goal: To have a straightforward and equal garden plot without conflict.

A.reason_for: Equal split is simple and avoids conflict.

C.reason_for: Crop grouping could simplify care and resource sharing.

D.reason_for: Effort-based seems fair but requires tracking.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a focused gardener who values fairness based on effort and preferences.
personas.private_goal: To have a plot size that reflects my preferences and the effort I put in.

A.reason_for: Equal split is simple but ignores effort and preferences.
A.reason_against: I want my plot size to reflect my input and preferences.

B.reason_for: Preference-based allocation respects individual crop needs and personal desires.

C.reason_for: Crop grouping helps with shared resources but limits personal control.
C.reason_against: I prefer more control over my own plot.

D.reason_against: Requires accurate tracking which may be difficult.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is an experienced gardener who values collaboration and efficiency.
personas.private_goal: To grow crops efficiently with others who share my crop type.

A.reason_for: Equal split is fair but ignores crop type grouping benefits.
A.reason_against: I prefer grouping by crop type for shared care.

B.reason_against: Unequal sizes may cause fairness issues.

C.reason_for: Grouping by crop type helps share resources and care efficiently.

personas.name: Ava
personas.background: Ava is a passionate gardener who values personal preferences and fairness.
personas.private_goal: To have a plot size that matches my crop preferences and effort.

A.reason_for: Equal split is fair but does not consider preferences or effort.
A.reason_against: I want my plot size to reflect my preferences.

B.reason_for: Preference-based allocation respects individual crop needs and personal desires.

C.reason_for: Crop grouping helps with shared resources but limits personal control.
C.reason_against: I prefer more control over my own plot.

D.reason_against: Requires accurate tracking which may be difficult.
